overall_summary: Analysis of 46 unique Shorts reveals clear bifurcation in traction: first-person extreme space survival scenarios ('What If You Fell Into...') and counter-intuitive astronomical extremes ('Day longer than year', 'TrES-2b') generate 700-1,000+ views with 2-4% like ratios. In contrast, repetitive uploads of psychology/brain facts ('Fake memories', 'Song stuck in head') and passive space trivia ('Silent space', 'Star older than universe') underperform severely (<100 views). Recent 7-day velocity confirms high demand for visceral, high-stakes planetary exploration.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Planetary Survival Hooks ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos using this exact phrasing achieved the channel's strongest numbers: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,024 views, 38 likes, 2 comments), 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (823 views, 15 likes), and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Anchor future space concepts around immediate physical immersion and survival stakes using 'What If You Fell Into...' or 'What If You Stood On...'.

winning_patterns.pattern: Counter-Intuitive Astronomical Paradoxes with Clear Numbers/Visuals
winning_patterns.evidence: Recent release 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' hit 980 views and 21 likes within 9 days (~108 views/day), while 'Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' scored 1,027 views and 36 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Pair stark astronomical physics paradoxes with visceral, cinematic comparisons rather than abstract astronomy.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple redundant uploads of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' achieved only 5, 10, and 53 views; 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' stalled at 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Halt recycled low-effort cognitive psychology uploads immediately; retire identical re-posts.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' plateaued across 3 attempts (34 to 220 views), and 'This Star Is Older Than the Universe!' hit only 11 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid standard school-textbook trivia; convert passive explanations into high-stakes scenarios or sensory shocks.
